data.name: monsterion
data.detailed_description:
Many Monsters. One open world. Every fight counts.

Monsterion is an open-world monster MMO. Pick your monster at start, choose well it's yours forever. Level it, gear it, and take it everywhere: into the wilds, into raids, into missions.

EXPLORE A LIVING WORLD

Your home is the monsterion village where there is shops, blacksmith, crafting, quest board, guild hall.

Beyond it, four wild biomes: the Whispering Forest, the Great Swamp, the Ashen Quarry, the Sunken Ruins. Harvest resources, crack open treasure chests, and share it all with up to 25 players in one persistent world.

LOOT. CRAFT. GROW STRONGER.

  • Six rarity tiers, from Common to Mythic; every drop rolls its own stats.

  • Named uniques worth hunting; Bloodthirster, Worldbreaker, Aegis of Ages, The Pale Horse.

  • Socket gems, reforge gear, and craft at the blacksmith to shape your build.

  • Go crit, vampire, tank, speed, or magic-find; then farm better loot, faster.

RAID GIANT MONSTER BOSSES

Hidden giants roam the far wilds. Gather your squad, track one down, and bring it down for the best loot in the game.

PROVE YOUR SKILLS IN DIFFERENT PVP MODES

  • Monster MOBA, classic 5v5 lanes. Lead your monster, push towers, topple the enemy core.

  • Humans vs Monsters, an asymmetric team battle. One side fights as humans, the other as monsters. Different sides, different powers, one arena.

ONE CHARACTER, EVERY MODE

Your gold, your level, your gear, they follow you across the whole game. Everything you earn in the wilds makes you stronger everywhere else.

data.short_description: A monster MMO with an open world to explore... Chase rare loot. Beat up giant bosses with your guild. Level up your monster. Craft and gear up. monsterion also has PvP with 5v5 MOBA lanes and Humans vs Monsters battles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 compatible GPU, 1 GB VRAM (Intel HD 620 / GeForce GTX 750 / Radeon R7 260)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560, 2 GB VRAM

  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
